svg.title: Workflow map: 26 GitHub Actions workflows across five repositories
svg.desc: Workflows per repository, grouped by trigger. On pull request: packer i915-compat, validate, format; terraform validate-and-plan, format, diagrams; ansible i915-compat, validate, format; apps validate-and-diff, format, diagrams. A person merges the pull request. On merge to main: packer build opens a manifest pull request in terraform; terraform apply sends a repository dispatch to ansible deploy; deploy installs Argo CD, which pulls the apps repository, and writes the KUBECONFIG_RAW secret used by terraform apply and apps refresh. Ansible also runs i915-sriov-upgrade, proxmox-backup, proxmox-guest-startup and ser2net when their paths change. Scheduled or manual: packer check-debian-iso, terraform drift, ansible i915-acceptance and csi-activation-preflight, apps image-scan. The .github repository has one workflow, diagrams.

g.text: host playbooks, each on its own paths

svg.text: org profile and cross-repo docs; its one workflow checks README images on pull requests
Most workflows can also be started by hand. Renovate opens dependency pull requests in all five repositories.
